<ic>To build a Folly in Afarjasse in the territory of Feroz dedicated to that location.

Self-funded.

<i>Proposed by Temeschwar, Seconded by Semmerholm</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* Passed

===Date===
* Winter 379YE

===Cost===
* The Senator may build any magnitude of folly. ([[Folly#Costs|Standard costs]] apply).

===Progress===
* 10 wains of white granite and 20 crowns provided by Gant Archama after Winter Solstice 379YE.

===Campaign Outcome===
* This folly is now complete.
